C1288.title: Epaylinks Payment Fined Over 48 Million Yuan for Violations of Payment Settlement, Fintech, and Anti-Money Laundering Rules
C1288.summary: Epaylinks Payment Co., Ltd. was fined over 48 million yuan by the Guangdong Provincial Branch of the People's Bank of China for breaches of payment settlement, fintech, and anti-money laundering regulations, marking the largest penalty in the industry for the first half of 2026.
